text.查找角色或资源 · 中文名 / 内部编号: Find a hero or resource by name or ID
text.选择功能，再选择资源，调整预览。地图可按编号筛选并查看图层、环境和图块信息。顶部: Open a tool, select a resource, and adjust the preview. Find maps by ID and inspect their layers, environment, and tiles. Use the search bar to find assets, heroes, and audio clip IDs across the library.
text.角色图鉴可按职业、属性和初始星级筛选，展示立绘、进化形态、时装、原始属性、专属武: Filter the Hero Codex by class, element, and starting rarity. Browse artwork, evolution stages, costumes, base stats, exclusive weapons, and stories from the original game data.
text.音频 收录 BGM、音效与语音，按内码和资源组筛选；选择后按需试听，支持循环、连: Browse music, sound effects, and voice lines by ID or asset group. Select a clip to preview it, loop it, play consecutive clips, or download the original audio.
text.选择一个角色后，顶部会显示其关联资源。图集卡片也可以直接打开像素动画、立绘或特效: Selecting a hero shows related resources in the header. Atlas cards also open related sprites, artwork, or effects. Your browser's back and forward buttons and shareable links work across the library.
text.资源旁的 ☆ / ★ 可收藏或取消收藏。收藏保存在当前浏览器，下次查询时在匹配结: Use ☆ or ★ to toggle a favorite. Favorites are saved in this browser and appear first in matching results. Right-click a star to edit aliases, or right-click a dropdown to search by alias. Use Aliases in the header to manage, import, or export your local aliases.
text.切换功能会释放当前预览。返回时保留资源选择；本地上传和未完成的导出请在当前功能中: Switching tools closes the current preview. Your resource selection is remembered when you return. Finish local uploads and exports before switching tools.
text.索引中没有对应资源: No matching resource in the index
text.部分资源索引读取失败，请刷新重试。: Some resource indexes failed to load. Refresh to try again.
text.未找到资源，可在各功能中选择图集或上传本地文件。: No matching resources. Open a tool to select an atlas or upload a local file.
text.选择图集后可按名称筛选、预览并下载单个切片: Select an atlas to filter, preview, and download individual sprites by name
text.输入内码或中文名进行筛选…: Filter by name or asset ID…
text.选择音效或音乐: Select a sound effect or track
text.保留游戏音频的原始采样率、声道和响度。选择后才加载音频；切换资源库功能时停止播放: Clips retain the game's original sample rate, channels, and loudness. Audio loads when selected and stops when you switch tools.
text.设置主目标与角色的距离: Set the distance between the hero and primary target
text.用于预览中的自动粒子种子和技能随机；资源保存的固定粒子种子仍使用原值。: Controls automatic particle seeds and skill randomness in previews. Fixed seeds stored in assets retain their original values.
text.控制下一张地图是否读取人物资源；会记住此选项: Load character assets when opening the next map. This setting is remembered.
text.粘贴 Ctrl+V；选中一个图块时以其位置为落点，否则使用视野中心: Paste Ctrl+V at the selected tile or the center of the view
text.删除所选图块 Delete，可撤销: Delete selected tiles. This can be undone.
text.复原当前地图的所有编辑，可撤销: Reset all edits to the current map. This can be undone.
text.移动半格 · 旋转 15° · 缩放 0.1 倍: Move ½ tile · Rotate 15° · Scale by 0.1
text.显示星片、紫币和已关联物品的原始资源: Show original assets for Star Pieces, Purple Coins, and linked items
text.搜索名称、图层或坐标: Search by name, layer, or coordinates
text.人物与特效导出为静态快照。: Characters and effects export as static snapshots.
text.点击播放时自动切到演示布局；可关闭并记住选择: Switch to presentation layout on playback. This setting is remembered.
text.先从地图人物列表选中角色，再点选路线或启用 WASD 走位，Shift 奔跑。键: Select a character, then click to draw a path or move with WASD and hold Shift to run. Undo recorded movement with Ctrl+Z. Paths stay on the character's plane and do not simulate collisions or find routes.
text.可依次选择人物与机关，在同一时间轴编排动作；同名机关多选可同时追加。使用的是各机: Select characters and mechanisms to arrange their actions on the same timeline. Select multiple mechanisms with the same name to add them together using their existing animations and lift settings.
text.跟随小公主的足迹，踏上森林中的冒险。: Follow the Little Princess into the forest.
text.WASD / 方向键移动，按住空格奔跑: WASD or arrows to move. Hold Space to run.
text.J / Z 攻击，空格交互 / 跳下高台: J or Z to attack. Space to interact or drop down.
text.点击对白 / 空格继续剧情: Click dialogue or press Space to continue
text.M 地图，Esc 暂停: M for map, Esc to pause
text.进度自动保存在当前浏览器。: Progress is saved automatically in this browser.
text.WASD 移动 · J 攻击 · 空格交互: WASD to move · J to attack · Space to interact
text.按住空格奔跑 · M 地图: Hold Space to run · M for map
text.小公主的足迹通往森林另一端。: The Little Princess's trail leads to the far side of the forest.
text.本关的当前进度将被新的冒险替换。: Starting over replaces your current progress in this stage.
text.中文名或内码 · ↑↓ 选择 Enter 载入: Name or ID · ↑↓ to select, Enter to load
text.时长自动锁定为动画一周: Duration is set to one animation cycle
text.导出范围（可在画布上拖动方框）: Export region (drag the box on the canvas)
text.使用上方范围、尺寸、时长与背景。MP4/MOV 无透明通道、无音轨；透明背景请选: Uses the region, dimensions, duration, and background above. MP4 and MOV have no alpha or audio. Choose a PNG sequence for transparency. Video dimensions are padded to even numbers.
text.固定默认 45°俯视方向，仍可平移和缩放: Lock the default 45° view while allowing pan and zoom
text.将当前预览视角设为主摄像头: Use the current preview view as the main camera
text.将属性修改写入当前时间的轨道: Write property changes to the track at the playhead
text.将所选对象的属性同步到当前时间: Sync the selected object's properties to the playhead
text.时间轴比例尺，Ctrl + 滚轮缩放: Timeline scale. Zoom with Ctrl + scroll.
text.放大选中的关键帧或片段: Zoom to the selected keys or clips
text.吸附到播放头、关键帧和片段端点；Alt 临时关闭: Snap to the playhead and to keyframe and clip edges. Hold Alt to suspend snapping.
text.截断区间或插入关键帧 K: Split duration clip or insert keyframe (K)
text.时间轴，空白处拖动框选，Ctrl 点选，Shift 连选: Drag on empty space to box select. Ctrl-click to toggle and Shift-click to select a range.
text.当前形态在满突破、满祝福时的等级上限: Maximum level for this form with full limit breaks and Blessing
text.基础属性 · 未觉醒 · 不含祝福加成: Base stats · No Awakening or Blessing bonuses
text.当前武器在满突破、铭刻后的等级上限: Maximum level for this weapon with full limit breaks and engraving
text.加载上传的图片失败: Failed to load the uploaded image
text.展开以读取来源和 SoundHandleSpec。: Expand to load source information and SoundHandleSpec.
text.音频读取失败，请重新选择后重试。: Unable to load audio. Select the clip again to retry.
text.攻击模组没有可播放素材: This attack module has no playable assets
text.请检查导出起止时间: Check the export start and end times
text.导出最多 1800 帧，请缩短范围: Shorten the export range to 1,800 frames or fewer
text.冒险遇到了问题。可以返回选关后继续。: Something interrupted the adventure. Return to stage selection to continue.
text.正在载入骑士与剧情人物…: Loading the Knight and story characters…
text.没有匹配的角色，请调整筛选。: No matching heroes. Try changing the filters.
text.请复制浏览器地址栏链接: Copy the link from the browser address bar
text.未找到指定角色，请从左侧目录选择。: Hero unavailable. Choose one from the catalog.
text.角色目录读取失败。: Failed to load the hero catalog.
text.别名须为文字列表: Aliases must be a list of strings
text.别名缺少资源标识: The alias entry has no resource ID
text.显示名称须来自别名列表: The display name must be one of the aliases
text.右键资源旁的星标设置别名: Right-click the star next to an asset to set its aliases
text.导出尺寸须在 1–4096 px 以内，总像素不超过 8M: Export dimensions must be 1–4096 px and the total must be at most 8 million pixels
text.请检查时长与帧率；最多导出 3600 帧: Check the duration and frame rate. Exports are limited to 3,600 frames.
text.此浏览器无法使用 WebCodecs 视频编码。请使用新版 Chromium 浏: WebCodecs encoding is unavailable. Use a recent Chromium browser or export a PNG sequence.
text.此设备不支持当前尺寸的 H.264 编码。请降低尺寸，或导出 PNG 序列: This device cannot encode H.264 at these dimensions. Reduce the dimensions or export a PNG sequence.
text.捕获帧尺寸与导出计划不一致: The captured frame dimensions do not match the export settings
text.PNG 序列超过 512 MiB，请缩短范围或降低尺寸: PNG sequence exceeds 512 MiB. Reduce the range or dimensions.
text.无法生成 PNG（请检查贴图的跨域权限）: Could not generate PNG. Check the texture's cross-origin permissions.
text.右键搜索选项或别名: Right-click to search options or aliases
text.人物索引加载失败，请刷新重试。: Failed to load the character index. Refresh to retry.
text.资源搜索索引读取失败: Failed to load the resource search index
text.击败敌人，打开通路: Defeat the enemies to open the passage
text.面向允许跳下的高台边缘，再按空格: Face an edge you can drop from, then press Space
text.点击对白 / 空格：继续: Click dialogue or press Space to continue
text.举起燃烧的物体，贴近火盆传火: Lift a burning object and bring it to the brazier
text.发现一张通往秘密区域的地图！: Found a map to a secret area!
text.在最近的安全地点重新出发: Restarting at the latest safe spot
text.浏览器未允许保存进度: The browser did not allow saving progress
text.可击碎挡路的小岩石。: Breaks small rocks that block the way.
text.原生道具说明 UI 读取失败: Failed to load the native item description UI
text.原生标题动画读取失败: Failed to load the native stage title animation
text.和小公主一起逃离森林: Escape the forest with the Little Princess
text.沿着小路寻找小公主: Follow the path to find the Little Princess
text.追上前方的小公主: Catch up with the Little Princess
text.寻找帮助，继续追赶小公主: Find help and catch up with the Little Princess
text.和罗兰茵一起穿过森林，前往出口: Cross the forest with Loraine and head for the exit
text.先和罗兰茵交谈，再继续追赶小公主: Talk to Loraine before following the Little Princess
text.觉醒树读取失败。: Failed to load the Awakening Tree.
text.觉醒树，可拖动、缩放和使用方向键移动: Awakening Tree. Drag, zoom, or pan with the arrow keys.
text.角色立绘，可拖动或使用方向键平移: Hero artwork. Drag or pan with the arrow keys.
text.当前浏览器无法播放 WebGL 动画，可查看图集预览: WebGL playback is unavailable in this browser. An atlas preview is available.
text.素材加载失败，点击“重试”重新加载: Asset failed to load. Select Try again to reload.
text.语音读取失败，请点击播放重试。: Unable to load audio. Press Play to retry.
text.语音播放失败，请点击播放重试。: Voice playback failed. Press Play to retry.
text.当前数据未收录该角色的台词文本。: No voice line transcripts are available for this hero.
text.没有匹配的台词，请调整搜索。: No matching voice lines. Try another search.
text.源文件无法解码: Source file could not be decoded
text.地图内容与目录资源校验值不符: The map contents do not match the checksum in the catalog
text.显示此地图已接入的粒子特效: Show this map's supported particle effects
text.此地图没有已接入的粒子发射器: This map has no supported particle emitters
text.地图已解码；此图没有可显示的静态模型。: The map decoded successfully and contains no displayable static models.
text.此文件尚未收录在地图目录中，暂未配备对应资源。: This file is outside the map catalog and has no bundled assets.
text.地图解码 Worker 无法启动: The map decoder worker did not start
text.此分支未能转换，不能继续；请尝试其他选项: This branch could not be converted. Select another option.
text.分支缺少选择节点: This branch has no choice node
text.路线已写入人物位置轨；点击播放预览: Path added to the character's position track. Play to preview.
text.先选中一个机关，或多个同名机关: Select one mechanism or several with the same name
text.先选中人物并在人物面板选择动作、朝向和表情: Select a character, then set their action, facing, and expression in the character panel
text.事件文件最大 2 MB: The event file limit is 2 MB
text.点击标尺定位 · 拖动片段移动 · 拖动两端调整时长 · 双击轨道插入 · Ct: Click the ruler to seek. Drag clips to move them or drag an edge to trim. Double-click a track to insert. Ctrl+Z undoes edits.
text.在地图中选中人物或机关，再用上方按钮插入片段。: Select a character or mechanism on the map, then use the buttons above to insert a clip.
text.点选轨道上的片段，即可编辑时间、动作、路径或对白。: Select a clip to edit its timing, action, path, or dialogue.
text.请在地图中选中一个目标: Select a target on the map
text.单次播放后保持末帧: Hold the last frame after playback
text.路径 X, Y, Z（每行一点）: Path X, Y, Z (one point per line)
text.每行须为 X, Y, Z 三个数值: Enter three values per line for X, Y, and Z
text.选择时剧情等待，人物循环动作继续。原生分支时序由脚本生成；修改节点时间后需要同步: The scene waits for a choice while looped character actions continue. Game scripts set the original branch timing. Sync the other branches after retiming a choice.
text.屏幕锚点（空为人物定位）: Screen anchor (leave empty to anchor to the character)
text.屏幕锚点须为 0–1 的两个数值: The screen anchor requires two values between 0 and 1
text.跟随人物（空为固定镜头）: Follow character (leave empty for a fixed camera)
text.时间轴须为 version:1，commands 最多 5000 条: Timeline must use version 1 and contain at most 5,000 commands
text.时间与时长须在 0–3600 秒内: Time and duration must be 0–3,600 seconds
text.片段结束时间不能超过 3600 秒: Clips must end at or before 3,600 seconds
text.点击物品搜索框载入装备图集: Focus the item search field to load the equipment atlas
text.当前清单没有对应资源: The current catalog has no matching asset
text.（切回 character 可重试）: (Switch back to the character folder to retry)
text.（本朝向无此挂点，状态保留）: (This attachment is unavailable in the current direction. Its state is saved.)
text.点这一行即选中该组件（画布上会描出它的范围）: Select this row to outline the component on the canvas
text.导出期间画布尺寸发生变化，请保持窗口大小并重新导出: The canvas was resized during export. Keep the window size fixed and export again.
text.点击资源列表添加角色，可重复添加。拖动角色放置，中键或 Alt＋拖动平移，滚轮缩: Click an asset to add a character. Drag a character to place it, middle-drag or Alt-drag to pan, and scroll to zoom.
text.在起点设置初始属性，再移动播放头修改属性或点击 ◆ 插入关键帧。位置、旋转和缩放: Set initial properties at the start. Move the playhead to make changes or click ◆ to insert a keyframe. Position, rotation, and scale interpolate linearly. Other properties change at keyframes.
text.在播放头记录当前角色的全部装备: Record all equipment for the current character at the playhead
text.动作自动匹配当前人物朝向，无需选择方向后缀: Actions automatically match the character's direction
text.场景最多容纳 100 个角色: A scene can contain up to 100 characters
text.时长须为 0.1–600 秒，且不能短于最后一个关键帧。: Duration must be 0.1–600 seconds and cannot end before the final keyframe.
text.时长自动锁定为场景长度: Duration is set to the scene length
text.在列表中选取组件: Select a component in the list
text.请等待地图准备完成: Wait for the map to finish loading
text.等待原生移动完成: Waiting for game movement to finish
text.请先还原正在控制该人物的时间轴: Restore the timeline controlling this character first
text.请选人物并在地图点选至少一个目的地: Select a character and choose at least one destination on the map
text.路线按当前人物所在平面连接；未运行碰撞、寻路、战斗或任务条件。: Paths connect points on the character's plane. Collisions, pathfinding, combat, and quest conditions are disabled.
text.烘焙贴图超过 512 MiB，请关闭特效快照、降低精度或只导出选中部分: Baked textures exceed 512 MiB. Disable effect snapshots, reduce resolution, or export selected tiles.
text.当前范围没有可导出的可见网格: No visible meshes in the selected range
text.项目已有修改，请重新生成提案: The project has changed. Generate a new proposal.
text.已应用分镜，可继续编辑或撤销: Storyboard applied. You can keep editing or undo it.
text.请先进入镜头自由视角: Switch to the free camera view first
text.近裁切须小于远裁切: The near clipping plane must be closer than the far plane
text.将镜头加入主时间轴: Add shot to the main timeline
text.人物目录读取失败: Failed to load the character catalog
text.搜索物品名称或图集内码: Search item names or atlas IDs
text.将播放头移到镜头结束前: Move the playhead before the end of the shot
text.此人物尚未在 GTFX 注册: This character is unavailable in GTFX
text.此角色没有可调用的 GTFX 动作: This character has no available GTFX actions
text.此对象没有可用机关状态: This object has no available mechanism states
text.位置跟随不能形成循环: Position follow targets must be acyclic
text.缩放倍率须大于零: Scale multiplier must be greater than zero
text.没有可跟随的实例对象: There are no instances to follow
text.顶点不能低于两端位置: The apex cannot be below either endpoint
text.镜头速度须大于 0.01 或小于 -0.01: Shot speed must be above 0.01 or below −0.01
text.缩放须大于零: Scale must be greater than zero
text.此时间已有关键帧: A keyframe already exists at this time
text.片段超出镜头: The clip extends beyond the shot
text.时间轴剩余空间不足: There is not enough room on the timeline
text.复制位置已有关键帧: A keyframe already exists at the destination
text.镜头剩余时长不足: The shot has insufficient time remaining
text.请先复制物件或人物: Copy an object or character first
text.旋转和缩放吸附；位置按分度吸附: Snap rotation and scale. Snap position by the configured increment.
text.导出区间须位于时间轴内，且结束时间大于开始时间: The export range must be on the timeline and end after it starts
text.请允许连接 Agent 的弹出窗口: Allow the pop-up to connect to the Agent
text.尚未连接：先运行 start-local.cmd，再在连接小窗允许连接: Run start-local.cmd, then approve the connection in the pop-up
text.分镜服务连接失败: Unable to connect to the storyboard service
text.当前页面已切换项目，请返回提案所属项目: Switch back to the project for this proposal
text.项目已有修改，请重新生成提案，或作为新项目打开。: The project has changed. Generate a new proposal or open this one as a new project.
text.动作不存在或不是人物主动作: This action is unavailable as a main character action
text.表情不适用于此角色: This character does not support the expression
text.此对象没有该属性轨道: This object has no track for the property
text.物品图集读取失败: Failed to load the item atlas
text.搜索装备名称或编号: Search equipment by name or ID
text.导出镜头不存在: The shot to export is missing
text.MP4 导出需要支持 WebCodecs 的 Chromium 浏览器和本机或: MP4 export requires Chromium with WebCodecs on localhost or HTTPS
text.设备不支持此 H.264 画幅，请降低分辨率: This device cannot encode H.264 at these dimensions. Lower the resolution.
text.设备不支持 AAC 音频编码: This device does not support AAC encoding
text.长按并左右拖动 · Shift 精调 · Alt 加速 · 右键设置分度: Hold and drag horizontally. Shift for fine control, Alt for faster adjustment, right-click to set the increment.
text.分度须大于零: The increment must be greater than zero
text.旧项目需要读取地图基准后再导出: Load the map reference before exporting this older project
text.GTFX 轨道须绑定人物: GTFX tracks must target a character
text.角色缺少 GTFX 动作配置: This character has no GTFX action configuration
text.位置轨迹需要此镜头中的其他实例对象: Position trajectories require other instances in this shot
text.粘贴的关键帧超出镜头: Pasted keyframes extend beyond the shot
text.粘贴的片段超出镜头: Pasted clips extend beyond the shot
text.此镜头不存在跟随目标: The follow target is unavailable in this shot
text.此镜头不存在 GTFX 主目标: The primary GTFX target is unavailable in this shot
text.此镜头不存在 GTFX 副目标: The secondary GTFX target is unavailable in this shot
